author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
is_not: a repair, reinterpretation or replacement of the scene-wide traversability verdict. hospital_collision_coverage_audit.json, physx_traversability_admissible, the candidate policy, the collision-probe contract, targetability and ownership semantics are all untouched.
chronology: 2. collector dependencies inspected at source, not assumed
3. obstacle-map role and ground-support role found to be separable
4. band mismatch discovered between the audit's classification and the collector's slab
5. this contract frozen, with G2 written as a measurement rather than an inherited pass
6. ONLY THEN are candidate routes to be evaluated
the amendment derives from the collector's actual dependencies, not from a wish to make Hospital pass

two_estimands.scene_wide_traversability: obstacle AND support completeness across the whole scene
two_estimands.collection_route_admissibility: a trustworthy obstacle map over the band the PLANNER queries, plus verified continuous support along the executed swept route
two_estimands.relationship: different questions, separate gates; neither supersedes the other

collector_dependency_evidence.grid_required: collect.py:207 run_episode asserts self._grid is not None
collector_dependency_evidence.refuses_without_map: build_occupancy raises: planning without a map is unsupported because a random-walk demonstrator yields temporal-distance labels uncorrelated with spatial proximity

region_below_slab.risk: HAZARDOUS — inside the robot band, below the slab, so invisible to the planner map
region_below_slab.example: a 5-9 cm threshold, step or cable tray

region_above_band.risk: conservative only — treated as an obstacle though the robot passes under it

band_mismatch_finding.consequence: blocking_coverage_fraction = 1.0 does NOT establish that the planner's obstacle map is trustworthy for the robot. G2 must therefore be measured, not inherited.

gates.G1_scene_identity: exact scene URL, ETag/digest and version frozen before collection

G2_obstacle_map_integrity.requirement: no geometry of blocking size lies in [floor_z+0.02, slab_min) unrepresented in the planner's occupancy map; i.e. the robot band below the slab must be empty of blocking-size geometry, or the slab must be lowered to cover it
G2_obstacle_map_integrity.status: MUST BE MEASURED — not satisfied by blocking_coverage_fraction = 1.0
G2_obstacle_map_integrity.failure_action: route rejected; do not lower the requirement

gates.G3_start_support: entire robot footprint supported on collidable geometry at the start pose
gates.G4_continuous_route_support: entire swept footprint remains on collidable support throughout; a single unsupported tile on the route FAILS
gates.G5_obstacle_clearance: swept robot volume does not intersect blocking collision geometry
gates.G6_end_support: entire footprint supported at the goal pose
gates.G7_camera: robot-mounted forward-facing RGB camera passes the frozen hard gate incl. negatives
gates.G8_controller: controller identity and configuration fixed and recorded
gates.G9_goal: goal image declared, acquired and sealed BEFORE motion; never the final observation
gates.G10_long_horizon: route meets the preregistered temporal/spatial thresholds
gates.G11_data: ordered RGB frames + position [T,2] + yaw [T] recorded correctly
gates.G12_evidence: evidence written and validated BEFORE app.close()
gates.admission_rule: ALL gates required; no averaging, no partial credit

long_horizon_thresholds.note: frozen here, before any route is evaluated
long_horizon_thresholds.derivation: GNM/ViNT context_size 5 and NoMaD context_size 3, plus len_traj_pred 8 for NoMaD; a route must supply valid sampling windows for all three, so the binding constraint is GNM/ViNT context 5 + horizon 5 = 10 frames consumed per sample

a_route_local_pass_does_not_mean: the scene can be used for arbitrary planning
claim_boundary.it_means_only: the specific declared collection route has a trustworthy obstacle map over the planner's queried band and continuous verified physical support

open_measurements_required_before_any_ro: enumerate ALL 23 collider-less meshes, not the 10 listed examples
measure whether any blocking-size geometry occupies [floor_z+0.02, 0.10)
